analytics_empty: Nobody on this server holds any currency yet.
cfghint_0_for_unlimited_a_ceiling_stops_: 0 for unlimited. A ceiling stops one lucky run ending the economy.
cfghint_0_to_disable_cuts_a_user_off_aft: 0 to disable. Cuts a user off after losing this much in 24h.
cfghint_consecutive_daily_claims_earn_an: Consecutive daily claims earn an escalating bonus
cfghint_lets_users_move_currency_out_of_: Lets users move currency out of reach of robbery
cfghint_lets_users_steal_from_each_other: Lets users steal from each other's wallets
cfghint_paid_per_interval_on_the_banked_: Paid per interval on the banked balance
cfghint_pays_better_than_work_but_fails_: Pays better than work but fails often enough to stay behind it on average
cfghint_scales_winnings_only_never_the_r: Scales winnings only, never the returned stake. Below 1.0 widens the house edge.
cfghint_share_of_the_robber_s_wallet_des: Share of the robber's wallet destroyed on failure
cfghint_share_of_the_target_s_wallet_a_s: Share of the target's wallet a success takes
cfghint_targets_holding_less_than_this_c: Targets holding less than this cannot be robbed
cfghint_turns_every_wagering_game_on_or_: Turns every wagering game on or off
config_bank_hint: Banked currency cannot be robbed. Interest is a faucet, so it is off by default.
config_robbery_hint: Off by default because it is disruptive in servers that did not opt into it. Only wallets can be robbed.
config_transfers_hint: Transfer tax is a sink: the taxed portion is destroyed rather than moved.
confirm_delete_item: Delete "{name}"? Everyone who owns one loses it.
confirm_reset: Reset every economy setting to its default?
games_empty: No games played in this window.
games_hint: RTP is what players actually got back per unit wagered. Above 100% means the game is printing currency and wants its payout multiplier lowered.
notify_item_needs_role: Role items need a role to grant
notify_save_failed_undone: Couldn't save economy settings. Your last change was undone.
page_subtitle: Money supply, payout rates, shop and balances
shop_consumable_hint: Can be used up after purchase
shop_empty: No shop items yet. Add one to give currency somewhere to go.
shop_hint: The shop is the economy's main sink. Without one, balances only ever accumulate.
shop_visible_hint: Members can see and buy this item
supply_empty: No ledger activity in this window.
supply_hint: Currency created minus currency destroyed. A line that only climbs means your faucets outpace your sinks.
transfer_tax_note: {amount} was destroyed as transfer tax over this window. Tax has no ledger row of its own, so it is derived from the gap between what senders paid and what recipients received.
